contracts.serverTransport: Unchanged v1, no migration or backend mutation this milestone
contracts.private: Nonce/fixed import identities and consent epochs live in protected non-App-Group backup-excluded private file; geometry first saved only after explicit reviewed Save. No private permission enabled by reservation.
contracts.cache: Task and receipt atomic replacement; both current app writers merge durable receipts across Undo/sync/snapshot replacement. Receipt has no name/nonce/coordinates; portable export excludes it. No wall-clock reclamation.
contracts.recovery: Exact saved task/incarnation/reference, current private pin/device/consent epoch, no cancellation, no previous/revoked journal entry. Existing intents keep their own replay semantics. Fresh native admission also checks epoch to reject in-flight prepares after off/on. Off-at-Save receipt cannot later activate after enable.
contracts.acknowledgement: Only matching server terminal response deletes matching protected header. Retry may finish metadata after task Undo, never rewrite task. Inbox command retries ack but still fetches other drafts if retry fails. Remote Finish not triggered solely by relaunch.
